headline: Inchcape Lowers Full-Year Margin Guidance to 5.5% on Australian Weakness
summary: Automotive distributor Inchcape trimmed its full-year operating margin guidance to 5.5%, citing ongoing operational and market challenges in its Australian operations.
why: Inchcape is an international automotive distribution and retail company operating across global vehicle supply chains.

impacts.name: Inchcape plc
impacts.why: Management cut full-year operating margin targets to 5.5% due to weakness in its Australian business.
